articles.headline: Jio Prepares for Record ₹30,000 Crore IPO Listing
articles.brief: Reliance Jio is gearing up to file its red herring prospectus for what is expected to be India's largest-ever initial public offering, valued at around ₹30,000 crores.

articles.headline: India's Ultra-Short-Term Borrowing Costs Hit Four-Year High
articles.brief: Domestic borrowing costs for ultra-short-term funds have spiked significantly, pushing the premium over the policy rate to a four-year high amid tighter market liquidity.

articles.headline: Air India Frankfurt-Delhi Flight Diverted Over Security Alert
articles.brief: An Air India flight from Frankfurt to Delhi was diverted to Jaipur following a suspected hijack and bomb threat alert, landing safely before undergoing thorough security checks.

articles.headline: Trump Administration Ends 540-Day H-1B Permit Extension
articles.brief: In a major blow to foreign professionals, the US administration has terminated the long-standing 540-day automatic work permit extension for eligible immigrants awaiting visa renewals.

articles.headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russia's Largest Data Center Facility
articles.brief: In a targeted infrastructure attack, Ukrainian drones successfully hit Russia's biggest data center, causing significant disruptions to digital operations and technical services.

articles.headline: Vande Bharat Express Test Runs Successfully at 180 Kmph
articles.brief: A newly manufactured 16-coach Vande Bharat Express set produced by RCF Kapurthala successfully completed high-speed trials reaching 180 kilometers per hour on the Mathura-Nagda section.

articles.headline: Ajinkya Rahane and Sourav Ganguly Play Cricket at Buckingham Palace
articles.brief: Former Indian cricket captains Ajinkya Rahane and Sourav Ganguly surprised onlookers by playing a friendly game of tennis-ball cricket with Britain's Prince William outside Buckingham Palace.

articles.headline: Cabinet Clears 78-Day Bonus for 11.4 Lakh Railway Employees
articles.brief: The Union Cabinet has approved a productivity-linked bonus worth over ₹2,000 crore for more than 11.4 lakh railway staff members ahead of the upcoming festive holiday season.

articles.headline: India to Meet 90 Percent Domestic Urea Demand by 2030
articles.brief: The Indian government aims to produce 90 percent of its domestic urea requirements locally by 2030 to bolster national food security and reduce exposure to volatile global markets.

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi Vows to Reclaim Jantar Mantar Protest Site
articles.brief: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized the detention of activists and vowed to reclaim Jantar Mantar as a public space for peaceful democratic demonstrations against the central government.

articles.headline: IEA Warns Diesel Shortages Could Persist Into 2027
articles.brief: The International Energy Agency has projected that global diesel shortages may continue to trouble energy markets well into 2027 due to ongoing supply disruptions and refinery constraints.

articles.headline: Chennai Hospital Organizes Breast Cancer Awareness Camp
articles.brief: A leading hospital in Chennai hosted a specialized community health workshop aimed at promoting early detection, screening protocols, and advanced treatment options for breast cancer.
